meta.what: Golden reference output for the zmanim engine. Any port must reproduce this exactly.
meta.renderNote: These are raw engine strings, before any rendering. underlineTime writes a U+00A0 straight after the underline sentinel, so every underlined value here reads {U}{NB}. The renderer strips whitespace immediately after the sentinel (nl2br in js/ui/sheet-view.js and weekNl2br in js/ui/week-view.js), so what reaches the page has one separator space, not two. Compare engine output against this file, and compare rendered output against this file with that strip applied.
